question: Does a defined, mirror-consistent, pitch-sensitive gravity drive exist for the exact JO zone C/E sets, computed kinematically from the body state of the exact B4 runtime, before any CNS exposure?
feasibility_inspection_before_registrati: Zero-pose raw-MJCF positions only (funiculus inertial centre, arista origin and inertial centre, compiled masses); hand arithmetic of the zero-pose tangent recorded as predictions in the design. No runtime (B4) state, no imposed rotation, no rate computed.

sources.populations: malecns_backend.embodiment.antennal_gravity_identity.populations over its hash-locked annotations; must equal docs/evidence/antennal-gravity-identity-v1/run/result.json body_ids

signal.anchor: a = world position of body <side>Funiculus (all funiculus hinges at its origin)
signal.axis: n = unit(xipos[<side>Funiculus] - a), distal a3 long axis
signal.lever: p = xipos[<side>Arista]; r_perp = (p - a) - ((p - a).n) n
signal.tangent: t = unit(n x r_perp), sign chosen so that t . x_head >= 0 (x_head = Head body x axis, world)
signal.drive: d = g_hat . t, g_hat = unit(model.opt.gravity); +d = gravity pulls the arista anteriorly

left_right_rule: Populations are Step A's four sets as reconstructed; identical per-neuron rule on both sides; no per-side gain, normalisation or synapse-count correction.
Primary quantities (Step B checks and Step C primary contrasts) are pitch-driven, within-side, or bilateral sums; no left-minus-right difference in CNS or motor output is interpreted as roll sensing.
Roll response is reported descriptively only. The left/right synapse asymmetry (C 5.31x, E 2.54x) is labelled in all outputs.

stimuli.base: exact B4 initial state; neck and antenna joints at their initial values
stimuli.rotation: root free-joint quaternion pre-multiplied by a world rotation; mj_forward only; qpos restored afterwards

checks.B0_frame: at the rest pose, per side: Thorax->Head direction has Thorax-frame x fraction > 0.99; |r_perp| > 0; |t . x_head| >= 0.7; |gravity| > 0
checks.B1_identity: the four bodyId sets equal Step A result body_ids exactly (C 31 L / 22 R, E 157 L / 110 R) and all map to dense indices
checks.B2_bounded: d finite and |d| <= 1 in every grid pose and the rest pose
checks.B3_mirror: |d_L - d_R| <= 0.05 in every pitch-grid pose (zero roll)
checks.B4_pitch_response: per side, d strictly monotonic (all successive differences of one sign, none zero) over the pitch grid

verdict.NOT_READY: B0 passes and any of B1-B4 fails

reported_not_gated: rest-pose d per side and per-set rates under G1 and G1_FLIP (labelled: left/right synapse asymmetry, as reconstructed)
d over the pitch and roll grids per side; slopes at 0 by central difference (+-5 deg), per radian
d_L - d_R over the roll grid
n and t in the Head frame at rest, per side
direction of rotation sign: d at pitch +10 deg vs -10 deg (whether +pitch about world y is nose-down is reported from the Head x axis z-component)
predictions_not_checks: Level stance (zero pose arithmetic): d about -0.1 to -0.2; under G1, E low tonic, C silent; runtime head pose may shift this.
Nose-down pitch makes d rise steeply (slope near 1 per radian).
Roll slope magnitude about 0.2 per radian, opposite sign on the two sides.
interpretation_limits: Static geometry only: no CNS, no physics stepping, no function shown.
Modelled kinematic transduction: true antennal stiffness and deflection magnitude are not modelled; 120 Hz is an engineering scale.
a3 axis from the mesh inertial centre and arista centre as lever are modelling assumptions; the textbook a3-rotation arrangement is recalled, not validated here.
Zone sign label G1 is arbitrary; Step C tests G1 against G1_FLIP.
Right-side JO reconstruction is far less connected; sets are used as reconstructed.
Runtime antenna joints are FlyGym default springs (stiffness 1.0) and the neck is passive (stiffness 10); the encoder reads pose, not joint angles.
No motor coordinate status changes (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
single_run: Executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed and pushed.
